algorithm.boundary: zero padding by 1024 samples on both sides
algorithm.event: maximum band energy in inclusive time window; earliest tie
algorithm.normalization: low band divided by its maximum over the entire track
algorithm.envelope: y=a*y_previous+(1-a)*x; a=exp(-0.010/tau); attack tau=.030 s when x>y_previous, release tau=.180 s otherwise
algorithm.sampling: linear interpolation of the 100 Hz envelope at output frame PTS
